tool_args.rationale: The W1 bridge signature maps to the two-layer inland-hub siphon. Seven rows span u_now and s_grad, resolving the major branch ambiguity; fit vmax, rho, and the signed square-root branch coefficient numerically. The model's fit result is captured for prediction.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No evidence of s_grad above the documented avalanche threshold; the acquired probe already gives wide gradient variation and strongly discriminates the open branch.
All observations use the same short horizon and the W1 bridge archive maps directly to the static node-C siphon; a trajectory batch is unnecessary for this mechanism.
No long-horizon evidence indicates reversal, and this is not the bridge signature's indicated mechanism.
The branch-discriminating low-gradient row is substantially elevated; the selected numerically fitted model allows either sign, and training evidence is expected to select the positive branch.
